metadata.title: MAPP 6025.7 Rev.1 Good Review Practice: Review of Marketing Applications for Breakthrough Therapy-Designated Drugs and Biologics That Are Receiving an Expedited Review
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: FDA staff procedure. Category: New Drug Review.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement:  A breakthrough therapy development program must generate substantial evidence of effectiveness and sufficient evidence of safety to meet the statutory standard for approval.
candidates.context:  A breakthrough therapy designation is not the same as a drug approval, and does not change the statutory standards for demonstrating safety and effectiveness.  This MAPP also addresses pre-BLA/NDA meetings, even though they are requested before a marketing application is submitted. This is because the marketing application is the subject of the pre-BLA/NDA meeting.

candidates.statement: o Results from clinical trials must indicate that the drug has demonstrated substantial improvement over existing therapies upon preliminary review of the marketing application.
candidates.context:  For a breakthrough therapy-designated drug to be considered for an expedited review: Effective Date: 3/9/15; 2/28/24 Page 2 of 11

candidates.statement: o The marketing application must be designated as a priority review; and o The review team must have determined that a first cycle approval is likely.
candidates.context: Effective Date: 3/9/15; 2/28/24 Page 2 of 11  If the application is designated as a priority review, the review team considers whether the marketing application qualifies for an expedited review.

candidates.statement:  There is a need to hold an Advisory Committee (AC) meeting. o The sponsor fails to engage in collaborative communications, such as failure to respond to information requests (IRs) in a timely manner.
candidates.context:  Unexpected application deficiencies are found.  The marketing application is of poor quality. o Unanticipated review issues arise. o The review team experiences an unexpected shift in work priorities or staffing.

candidates.statement: Pre-NDA/BLA Meeting  Review teams should refer to MAPP 6030.9 Good Review Practice: Good Review Management Principles and Practices for Effective IND Development and Review for logistics of the pre-NDA/BLA meeting. Additional suggested topics for discussion include:
candidates.context: If the CDER review team determines an expedited review is no longer appropriate, the review timeline defaults to the priority review designation timeline. ORO staff communicates this decision and the rationale, to the applicant within five working days. o CDER statement of intent to conduct an expedited review of the application.
